name: Dev Tools
author: VanillaGreen
description: A panel over a catalog of coding agents, developer apps, CLI tools, languages, editors, databases and terminals, with each tool's state and Install, Update and Remove in a floating TUI, and a VGS section with how VGS is installed and every missing requirement. Open it with vgsh ipc call vgs.devtools invoke open.

writeLaunchers.label: Write launchers
writeLaunchers.description: Write a launcher in ~/.local/bin for every agent, app and tool, which installs it through mise on first run; VGS never replaces or deletes a file it did not write

placement.label: Placement
placement.description: Where the Dev Tools panel opens on its monitor

requirements.purpose: Installs, updates and removes the tools the Dev Tools catalog lists

mise.label: mise
mise.hint: Installs, updates and removes every tool the Dev Tools panel lists

checks.label: Checks
checks.hint: Whether every query the service runs answered; a count a failed query feeds keeps its last answer

outdated.label: Updates available
outdated.hint: Tools mise can update, as mise outdated counts them

missingRequirements.label: VGS requirements missing
missingRequirements.hint: Commands VGS or an enabled plugin runs that are not on PATH
